name: uxd-a11y-plan
title: Plan accessible work
description: Define accessibility scope, user tasks, role ownership and verification methods for a new feature, prototype or review.

name: uxd-a11y-research
title: Plan inclusive research
description: Prepare accessible research participation and analyze observed accessibility barriers in user tasks; do not substitute simulated personas for participant evidence.

name: uxd-a11y-content
title: Review accessible content
description: Write or review text alternatives, structure, labels, errors, tables, media and localization intent for an accessible experience.

name: uxd-a11y-design
title: Specify accessible interaction intent
description: Review designs and specify reading order, contrast, adaptation, focus, states and alternatives before implementation.

name: uxd-a11y-source-audit
title: Review accessibility in source
description: Review semantic HTML, component APIs and accessibility relationships in a scoped source target or diff.

name: uxd-a11y-runtime-review
title: Review a running accessible experience
description: Evaluate scoped browser tasks using available keyboard, semantic, visual, automated and human AT evidence methods.

name: uxd-a11y-test-gen
title: Generate targeted accessibility tests
description: Turn an identified accessibility expectation or failure into tests using the project’s installed framework and real components.

name: uxd-a11y-release
title: Assemble accessibility release evidence
description: Consolidate existing accessibility evidence, coverage, unresolved barriers, owners and retest needs for a build or release.
